query:
What did the group decide about where to go for drinks after dinner? Did everyone seem equally on board?

Options:
A. Jordan
B. Maya
C. Priya
D. Sam
context:
[1] (about=Maya, episodic, t3 @2025-01-20T17:47:00) ok so after ramen, drinks?
[2] (about=Priya, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T10:15:00) does wine country work for everyone? honestly it looks incredible, big old house, little tasting room, and enough space that we wouldn't be yelling over strangers
[3] (about=Priya, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T10:58:00) oh wait are you still off drinks? I'll see if they do good mocktails 😊
[4] (about=Maya, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T10:57:00) ngl I'll probably just get the sparkling water
[5] (about=Priya, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T19:02:00) honestly a rooftop sounds perfect

[7] (about=Priya, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T09:57:00) Lena and I will grab the table, she needs someone to help decode the menu anyway 😂
[8] (about=Priya, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T09:52:00) Jordan!! 😭 this is like the third time
[9] (about=Maya, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T10:01:00) Jordan you are genuinely missing out ngl
[10] (about=Jordan, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T10:04:00) noted.
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Priya, group-interaction, t6 @2025-01-27T10:15:00) Wine country trip decided for last weekend of the month; carpooling; Lena to check food/dietary options.
[12] (about=Lena, core, t6 @2025-01-27T10:15:00) Prefers to check menus in advance for dietary needs.
[13] (about=Maya, core, t6 @2025-01-27T10:15:00) Currently off drinks; will get sparkling water.
agent_answer:
The group decided to go to **wine country** — the tasting-room/winery place Priya suggested — for drinks after dinner.

No, not everyone seemed equally on board. **Jordan** was the noncommittal/holdout one: Priya called him out (“Jordan!! 😭 this is like the third time”), Maya said he was “genuinely missing out,” and Jordan only replied “noted.” **Maya** and **Priya** were on board (Maya planned to get sparkling water since she’s off drinks; Priya suggested the place and even offered to check mocktails). **Sam’s** stance is not mentioned in the conversation.

So the answer among the options is: **A. Jordan**.
